description: On macOS hosts, check:coverage fails via the environment-sensitive readyz runtime test (expects no-bwrap => 503, gets 200 under full-suite order; passes standalone). Pre-existing, Linux CI green. Tracked as warren-4de5.
resolution: Not yet fixed — tracked as warren-4de5. For release commits on macOS, use git commit --no-verify and document the bypass in the commit message; CI remains the authoritative gate.
